summary.headline: Sun in the Planetary Houses
summary.text: Chapter IV interprets the Sun in the houses of Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, and the Sun itself, including effects on fathers, wealth, health, status, conduct, sudden death, and relations with princes and neighbors; Aries and Scorpio are also discussed.
